query: Which safeguards (blinded assessment, de-linked career metrics, opt-out routes) most effectively mitigate gaming and reputation harms from virtue-based indicators?

response.query: Which safeguards (blinded assessment, de-linked career metrics, opt-out routes) most effectively mitigate gaming and reputation harms from virtue-based indicators?
response.answer: Blinded assessment, de-linked career metrics, and opt-out routes effectively mitigate gaming and reputation harms from virtue-based indicators by ensuring unbiased evaluations, separating personal achievements from reputational metrics, and allowing individuals to opt out of performance tracking.
